Name: Event Lookup Cherry Blossom UI
Author: IkarosHDD
Description:
This mod simply replaces the two png's found in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8505]EventLookup[/url] with my edited version meant to match with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25141]Cherry Blossom UI

[/url]I tried for a while to use content patcher to replace the png files, but I couldn't figure it out so abit of manual work is required. (see below)

If and at anytime if [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/shekurika?gameId=1303]shekurika[/url] wishes me to I'll take down this mod.

[size=5][color=pink]~Mod Description~[/color]
[/size]
- Changes [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8505]EventLookup[/url] button texture to match [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25141]Cherry Blossom UI[/url] theme

﻿[size=5][color=pink]~Installation~[/color]
[/size]
[size=3]1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8505]EventLookup
[/url]2. Download this mod
3. Inside \assets folder of this mod copy and replace contents into ﻿\assets folder of Eventlookup
[/size][size=3]4. Enjoy!

[/size][size=5][color=pink]~Uninstallation~[/color][/size]

[size=3]Either remove [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8505]EventLookup[/url][size=3] or reinstall EventLookup
